gold: Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome–A (MIS-A) with Diffuse Alveolar Hemorrhage
e7_s4_rationale: The patient's presentation with hemoptysis, elevated inflammatory markers, and bronchoalveolar lavage with increasing bloody return supports this diagnosis. Additionally, the chest radiograph and CT pulmonary angiogram showing bilateral nodular infiltrates and patchy opacities are consistent with diffuse alveolar hemorrhage.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Goodpasture syndrome
e7_s4_rejected.why: No mention of anti-GBM antibodies or renal involvement

e7_s4_rejected.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
e7_s4_rejected.why: No evidence of granulomatous inflammation or upper respiratory tract involvement

e7_s4_rejected.label: Microscopic polyangiitis
e7_s4_rejected.why: No evidence of vasculitis or renal involvement

e7_s4_rejected.label: Pulmonary capillaritis
e7_s4_rejected.why: While possible, the presentation is more consistent with diffuse alveolar hemorrhage given the radiographic findings and bronchoalveolar lavage results
